description: Vehicle must remain farther than minimal distance from other objects
ParkingPilot must activate only on user request
ParkingPilot must allow activation only in OOD
Vehicle must park inside the boundaries offered to user
Vehicle acceleration/deceleration must not reach levels poentially harmful to people
ParkingPilot must offer all valid parking spaces within 5m radius of the vehicle
ParkingPilot must consider as valid only parking spaces larger than the vehicle by a set margin
ParkingPilot must consider as valid only parking spaces with no obstacle or curb between it and the vehicle
ParkingPilot must execute the parking maneuvre in <=10 moves
If vehicle violates minimum distance to obstacle, ParkingPilot must abort the parking manuevre and stop the vehicle
Driver must have the ability to abort the parking manuevre at any time
Vehicle must maintain safe distance to objects
If the vehicle violates the minimum safe distance, the violation must be detected, and measures must be taken to prevent collision.
The vehicle velocity must not exceed of 30 km/h.
If the vehicle velocity exceeds 30 km/h, the violation must be detected, and the vehicle must slow down to a velocity below 30 km/h.
The vehicle velocity in a turn must not exceed of 20 km/h.
If the vehicle velocity in a turn exceeds 20 km/h, the violation must be detected, and the vehicle must slow down to a velocity below 20 km/h.
The vehicle must not impede the operation of emergency services.
If the vehicle impedes the operation of emergency services, this must be detected, andmeasures must be taken to remove any impediment to emergency services.
If the vehicle loses connection to the operator, this must be detected and reported, and the vehicle must stop at the nearest stop station.
When an emergency stop is necessary, the vehicle must stop.
The vehicle must not move while serving passengers who are not safely seated.
If the vehicle attempts to move while serving passengers who are not safely seated, this must be detected and measures must be taken to prevent the vehicle from moving.
